name: Advanced Computational Fluid Dynamics
description: Fluid flow governing equations, derivatives in curvilinear coordinates (covariant and contravariant basis), Delaunay triangulation for unstructured grid generation, higher order finite difference schemes (compact, spectral difference, etc), higher order upwind schemes, governing equations in rotating frame, semi-implicit time marching methods, discretization for turbulent flows, parallel computation in CFD, special topics (multiphase/compressible/meshless/multigrid etc)
